name: Clay pot rice
description: Rice cooked in a clay pot with sausage and chicken until a crust forms at the base.

tcm.note: Rice with cured sausage, cooked dry.

ayurveda.note: Ushna; the lap cheong is cured and sweet.

histamine.note: Cured Chinese sausage on top — that is the high part, not the rice.

nutrition.highlight: the crust at the bottom is the prize
